palette: patina bronze-brown ground + ritual bronze plaques + ochre inscriptions + seal-red lacquer accents + pale rubbing-paper insets
typography: ochre inscribed headings on bronze plaques, dark chronicle label tabs with seal-red left bar, seal-red stamps reserved for verdicts, pale rubbing insets for quotations, thin ink underline for tests
composition: the ideology pair hangs as twin bronze plaques; the marriage bench lays the three principles, six rites and seven-out three-back rows on rubbing paper; the judicature scene inscribes the judge hierarchy and the five-listen three-ask technique
surface: flat patina ground with faint inscription hairlines, bronze panels with hairline weathered borders and corner rivets, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: inscriptions carve onto plaques, rubbing insets paste on with a press, the seal stamps land once per verdict, the rite row unfolds left to right
transition: a rubbing sheet lifts and the chronicle clears for the next plate
